_comment: 'At the start of your turn, destroy Blessing of Steel then your next weapon attack this turn gains +2{p}.' Shape copied from shipped dyn/blessing_of_focus_red (same set, same Aura, same 'At the start of your turn, destroy...' wording). START_OF_TURN needs no IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER gate: engine._dsl_start_of_turn_listener dispatches it only to the TURN PLAYER's arena zones, and auras are among them (_dsl_permanent_zones includes player.auras) - verified, not assumed. Effect order follows the printed sentence: DESTROY_SELF first (effect form verified at effect_types.py:2406 - bare form destroys the source via canonical destroy()), then MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues on the controller's dsl_queued_attack_mods (handler reads mod/amount/filter/scope, effect_types.py:4511), so destroying the aura first cannot unqueue the pump. One-shot consumption by the first qualifying attack IS the release note ('applies to the next weapon attack only ... not to any additional weapon attacks'); unused mods expire end of turn. filter ATTACK_IS_WEAPON takes no params and reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198). All four triage primitives used as named; no gaps.
